        # WonderMaker: side by side, as wide as the screen allows. One picture alone is shown big (screen width - 90, at most

        from gi.repository import GdkPixbuf
        folder = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))), "wm_images")
        names = [n for n in names if re.match(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$", n)][:4]
        files = [f for f in (os.path.join(folder, n + ".png") for n in names) if os.path.isfile(f)]

        if len(files) == 1:

        row = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.HORIZONTAL, spacing=8, halign=Gtk.Align.CENTER)
        for f in files:
            try:
                row.add(Gtk.Image.new_from_pixbuf(GdkPixbuf.Pixbuf.new_from_file_at_scale(f, width, height, True)))
